role_agent_name: Fire marshal and public safety inspector (SAFE)
abstract: Maintains municipal life-safety occupancy clearances and emergency egress certifications
system_message:
You are the Fire marshal and public safety inspector (SAFE), responsible for maintaining municipal life-safety occupancy clearances and emergency egress certifications for convention facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency egress simulation（EVAC）
information_points.content:
SAFE-EVAC-W1H：According to the emergency egress crowd movement simulation for Bayside Oceanarium Conference Center at maximum seated capacity in the primary auditorium, the full plenary clearance duration is 10 min.
SAFE-EVAC-3W0：According to the emergency egress crowd movement simulation for Pacific Rim Maritime Pavilion at maximum seated capacity in the primary auditorium, the full plenary clearance duration is 6 min.
SAFE-EVAC-8R0：According to the emergency egress crowd movement simulation for Cascadia Waterfront Expo Hall at maximum seated capacity in the primary auditorium, the full plenary clearance duration is 8 min.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal life-safety occupancy clearances and emergency egress certifications（INSP）
information_points.content:
SAFE-INSP-ZCR：For Pacific Rim Maritime Pavilion, municipal fire marshal life-safety clearance is granted across the overall convention center complex based on a current approved fire safety inspection certificate and assembly occupancy permit.
SAFE-INSP-KM9：For Bayside Oceanarium Conference Center, municipal fire marshal life-safety clearance has not been granted for the overall convention center complex, as it lacks a current approved fire safety inspection certificate and assembly occupancy permit.
SAFE-INSP-XUU：For Cascadia Waterfront Expo Hall, municipal fire marshal life-safety clearance is granted across the overall convention center complex based on a current approved fire safety inspection certificate and assembly occupancy permit.
